content.short: KPK is a non-custodial onchain asset manager running tokenized funds, curated vaults and treasury mandates for DAOs and institutions.
content.description: KPK manages onchain capital without taking custody of it. Clients keep their assets, and KPK acts through tightly scoped permissions with automated risk checks. Its products include tokenized funds, curated lending vaults and custom treasury mandates. The team has been active since 2020, has carried out many thousands of onchain transactions, and reports that no client funds have been lost. It reports more than $8 billion deployed across DeFi, publishes regular treasury reports, and runs vaults such as USDC lending against real-world asset collateral.
